question: I would like to know the given names of baseball players who have achieved the highest value of games played, runs, hits, and home runs, with their corresponding score values.
sql:
WITH career_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(g AS DOUBLE)) AS INTEGER) as career_g,
    TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(r AS DOUBLE)) AS INTEGER) as career_r,
    TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(h AS DOUBLE)) AS INTEGER) as career_h,
    TRY_CAST(SUM(TRY_CAST(hr AS DOUBLE)) AS INTEGER) as career_hr
  FROM batting
  GROUP BY player_id
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT 
    player_id,
    career_g,
    career_r,
    career_h,
    career_hr,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY career_g DESC) as rank_g,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY career_r DESC) as rank_r,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY career_h DESC) as rank_h,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY career_hr DESC) as rank_hr
  FROM career_stats
)
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'games_played' as category,
  r.career_g as score
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE r.rank_g = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'runs' as category,
  r.career_r as score
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE r.rank_r = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'hits' as category,
  r.career_h as score
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE r.rank_h = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT 
  p.name_given,
  'home_runs' as category,
  r.career_hr as score
FROM ranked r
JOIN player p ON r.player_id = p.player_id
WHERE r.rank_hr = 1
ORDER BY score DESC
